integrity: The general statement is proved symbolically from order preservation and finiteness. The verifier is dependency-free and independently checks all labeled posets on at most four points plus the first three canonical ordinal-sum models. Literature searches establish noncoverage only relative to the inspected sources and queries, not absolute novelty.
scientific_limitations: The theorem assumes incomparability degree at most one and does not extend as stated to arbitrary width-two finite posets. The exhaustive checker covers only small labeled posets and is corroborative, not the proof of the general theorem.
title: Almost-chain finite spaces without the fixed point property are exactly minimal sphere models
